note: Cloud accounting and ERP for Brazilian small businesses (Joinville). Ribbit came in on the Series A: 'ContaAzul raises Series A from Monashees, Ribbit Capital, 500Startups and Napkn Ventures' (The Next Web, 2013-01-07), the round of the company's first Form D (sale date 2012-09-10, $2.76M); the firm listed ContaAzul on 19 December 2012, before the 2013 filing the Form D band had read as a Seed entry. Ribbit led the Series C (LAVCA, February 2015). Visma agreed to buy Conta Azul in August 2025 (LatamList, pending CADE) and presents it as part of Visma (January 2026), so the known 'acquired' stands. A Series A entry takes no graduation.
